content.text: {"ok":true,"name":"Source_gen","category":"sources","description":"This routine is a neutron source (rectangular or circular), which aims at a square target centered at the beam (in order to improve MC-acceptance rate). The ...","parameters":[{"name":"flux_file","type":"string","unit":"str","default":"\"NULL\"","required":false,"doc":"Name of a two columns [lambda flux] text file that contains the wavelength distribution of the flux in either [1/(s*cm**2*st)] or [1/(s*cm**2*st*AA)] (see flux_file_perAA flag) Comments (#) and further columns are ignored. Format is compatible with McStas/PGPLOT wavelength monitor files. When specified, temperature and intensity values are ignored."},{"name":"xdiv_file","type":"string","unit":"str","default":"\"NULL\"","required":false,"doc":"Name of the x-horiz. divergence distribution file, given as a free format text matrix, preceeded with a line '# xylimits"},{"name":"ydiv_file","type":"string","unit":"str","default":"\"NULL\"","required":false,"doc":"Name of the y-vert. divergence distribution file, given as a free format text matrix, preceeded with a line '# xylimits"},{"name":"radius","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Radius of circle in (x,y,0) plane where neutrons are generated. You may also use 'yheight' and 'xwidth' for a square source"},{"name":"dist","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Distance to target along z axis."},{"name":"focus_xw","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.045,"required":false,"doc":"Width of target."},{"name":"focus_yh","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.12,"required":false,"doc":"Height of target."},{"name":"focus_aw","type":"double","unit":"deg","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"maximal (uniform) horz. width divergence"},{"name":"focus_ah","type":"double","unit":"deg","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"maximal (uniform) vert. height divergence"},{"name":"E0","type":"double","unit":"meV","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Mean energy of neutrons."},{"name":"dE","type":"double","unit":"meV","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Energy spread of neutrons, half width."},{"name":"lambda0","type":"double","unit":"AA","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Mean wavelength of neutrons."},{"name":"dlambda","type":"double","unit":"AA","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Wavelength spread of neutrons,half width"},{"name":"I1","type":"double","unit":"1/(cm**2*sr)","default":1.0,"required":false,"doc":"Source flux per solid angle, area and Angstrom if I1=0, the source emits 1 in 4*PI whole space."},{"name":"yheight","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.1,"required":false,"doc":"Source y-height, then does not use radius parameter"},{"name":"xwidth","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.1,"required":false,"doc":"Source x-width, then does not use radius parameter"},{"name":"verbose","type":"double","unit":"0/1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"display info about the source. -1 inactivate source."},{"name":"T1","type":"double","unit":"K","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Temperature of the Maxwellian source, 0=none"},{"name":"flux_file_perAA","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"When true (1), indicates that flux file data is already per Aangstroem. If false, file data is per wavelength bin."},{"name":"flux_file_log","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"When true, will transform the flux table in log scale to improve the sampling."},{"name":"Lmin","type":"double","unit":"AA","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Minimum wavelength of neutrons"},{"name":"Lmax","type":"double","unit":"AA","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Maximum wavelength of neutrons"},{"name":"Emin","type":"double","unit":"meV","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Minimum energy of neutrons"},{"name":"Emax","type":"double","unit":"meV","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Maximum energy of neutrons"},{"name":"T2","type":"double","unit":"K","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Second Maxwellian source Temperature, 0=none"},{"name":"I2","type":"double","unit":"1/(cm**2*sr)","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Second Maxwellian Source flux"},{"name":"T3","type":"double","unit":"K","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Third Maxwellian source Temperature, 0=none"},{"name":"I3","type":"double","unit":"1/(cm**2*sr)","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Third Maxwellian Source flux"},{"name":"zdepth","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Source z-zdepth, not anymore flat"},{"name":"target_index","type":"int","unit":"1","default":1,"required":false,"doc":"relative index of component to focus at, e.g. next is +1 this is used to compute 'dist' automatically."}]}

The OFF/PLY file may be generated from XYZ coordinates using qhull/powercrust."},{"name":"format","type":"vector","unit":"no quotes","default":"{0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0}","required":false,"doc":"Name of the format, or list of column indexes (see Description)."},{"name":"radius","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Outer radius of sample in (x,z) plane"},{"name":"yheight","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Height of sample y direction"},{"name":"xwidth","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Horiz. dimension of sample, as a width"},{"name":"zdepth","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Depth of box sample"},{"name":"thickness","type":"double","unit":"m","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Thickness of hollow sample. Negative value extends the hollow volume outside of the box/cylinder."},{"name":"pack","type":"double","unit":"1","default":1.0,"required":false,"doc":"Packing factor."},{"name":"Vc","type":"double","unit":"AA^3","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Volume of unit cell=nb atoms per cell/density of atoms."},{"name":"sigma_abs","type":"double","unit":"barns","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Absorption cross section per unit cell at 2200 m/s. Use a negative value to inactivate it."},{"name":"sigma_inc","type":"double","unit":"barns","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Incoherent cross section per unit cell. Use a negative value to inactivate it."},{"name":"delta_d_d","type":"double","unit":"0/1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Global relative delta_d_d/d broadening when the 'w' column is not available. Use 0 if ideal."},{"name":"p_inc","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.1,"required":false,"doc":"Fraction of incoherently scattered neutron rays."},{"name":"p_transmit","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.1,"required":false,"doc":"Fraction of transmitted (only attenuated) neutron rays."},{"name":"DW","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Global Debye-Waller factor when the 'DW' column is not available. Use 1 if included in F2"},{"name":"nb_atoms","type":"double","unit":"1","default":1.0,"required":false,"doc":"Number of sub-unit per unit cell, that is ratio of sigma for chemical formula to sigma per unit cell"},{"name":"d_omega","type":"double","unit":"deg","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Horizontal focus range (only for incoherent scattering), 0 for no focusing."},{"name":"d_phi","type":"double","unit":"deg","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Angle corresponding to the vertical angular range to focus to, e.g. detector height. 0 for no focusing."},{"name":"tth_sign","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Sign of the scattering angle. If 0, the sign is chosen randomly (left and right). ONLY functional in combination with d_phi and ONLY applies to bragg lines."},{"name":"p_interact","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.8,"required":false,"doc":"Fraction of events interacting coherently with sample."},{"name":"concentric","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Indicate that this component has a hollow geometry and may contain other components. It should then be duplicated after the inside part (only for box, cylinder, sphere)."},{"name":"density","type":"double","unit":"g/cm^3","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Density of material. rho=density/weight/1e24*N_A."},{"name":"weight","type":"double","unit":"g/mol","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Atomic/molecular weight of material."},{"name":"barns","type":"double","unit":"1","default":1.0,"required":false,"doc":"Flag to indicate if |F|^2 from 'reflections' is in barns or fm^2 (barns=1 for laz, barns=0 for lau type files)."},{"name":"Strain","type":"double","unit":"ppm","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Global relative delta_d_d/d shift when the 'Strain' column is not available. Use 0 if ideal."},{"name":"focus_flip","type":"double","unit":"1","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"Controls the sense of d_phi. If 0 d_phi is measured against the xz-plane. If !=0 d_phi is measured against zy-plane."},{"name":"target_index","type":"int","unit":"1","default":0,"required":false,"doc":"Relative index of component to focus incoherent scattering at, e.g. next is +1"},{"name":"order","type":"int","unit":"1","default":1,"required":false,"doc":"Flag that determines whether the intensity should (1) not (0) be dampened by weighting multiple scattering"}]}

V_rho=density/weight/1e24*N_A"},{"name":"weight","type":"double","unit":"g/mol","default":0.0,"required":false,"doc":"atomic/molecular weight of material"},{"name":"p_interact","type":"double","unit":"1","default":-1.0,"required":false,"doc":"Force a given fraction of the beam to scatter, keeping intensity right, to enhance small signals (-1 inactivate)."},{"name":"norm","type":"double","unit":"1","default":-1.0,"required":false,"doc":"Normalize S(q,w) when -1 (default).
